items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: my father brought me to Professor Chambroka... It’s still there, the hall where I took my first lesson. Prof Chambroka... was an excellent teacher

ctx.x: Did you take trumpet lessons in school? © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

No, my father brought me to Professor Chambroka who was with the Rome White Band Hall which is opposite Second Street if you know Rome. It’s still there, the hall where I took my first lesson. Prof Chambroka was a graduate of Milan Conservatory in Italy, and was an excellent teacher, but he just taught music. He wasn’t a trumpet teacher. He taught music. He was a clarinet player originally himself. So he taught great clarinet. He brought up some great clarinet players there.
